messages.text:
BL-866 — Offline-first foundation (bridge): a companion-manifest advertising versioned JSON packages with generations, so a phone can refresh only what changed
What it solves: The generation is the cache key the whole epic depends on: the phone-side
slice caches by it, the outbox slice will reconcile against it. Whatever
identifies a generation must change whenever the package content changes, or
a phone will hold stale data believing it is current — worth the architect'…
Approval context: Sign-off is carried by the epic BL-865 (bridge as sync source, REST + JSON over protobuf, only the foundation minted so far). Nothing extra is asked here.
BL-866 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-866" (or "reject BL-866 <reason>") to act.
